headline: On the committed offline fixture (n=44 Jev items, not a scored live run), the OLS slope of uniform ECE vs tier accuracy is -0.1356 (95% bootstrap CI [-1.4201, 0.8411], 10000 resamples, seed=20260919). Inspect per-tier occupancy before interpreting ECE; this pack is a harness check, not the EXP-1 claim.
